violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Ice cream scoop found in dirty standing water. Ice cream scoops should be stored in container with running water or an ice bath that is changed as necessary.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Food to go containers were found on the floor. Single use items should be stored off of the floor.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Paper towel dispenser was found empty at the hand sink. Paper towels should be available at all times.
